data.name: Supersonic Fight
data.detailed_description:
Supersonic Fight is a modern combat flight game built around authentic jet handling and cinematic, story-driven missions. Take part in high-stakes battles over San Francisco where timing, precision, and decisive strikes determine survival. Every mission is carefully briefed. Every action has consequences. Every victory pushes the war forward.

For over three decades, the USS Enterprise (CVN-65) has operated off the California coast, its carrier air wing standing watch over San Francisco’s skies. With funding slashed and defenses weakened, a long-waiting enemy seizes its moment. You strap into the cockpit—outnumbered, outpaced, and under relentless pressure—as the fate of the city hangs in the balance.

Story-Driven Single-Player Campaign

Experience a full narrative campaign of escalating combat missions. Build trust within your squadron, answer to your commanding officer, and confront an enemy that adapts and intensifies as the conflict unfolds.

Purposeful Mission Design

Escort, intercept, defend, and strike in missions where timing and positioning matter as much as firepower. Arrive too soon or a moment too late—and feel the consequences.

Multiplayer Combat Modes

Test your skill against other pilots in competitive multiplayer modes including Dogfight, team battles, objective-based missions, and VIP engagements. Skill, awareness, and precision decide who controls the skies.

Free Flight Mode

Fly without objectives or restrictions. Choose your aircraft, climb into the stratosphere or skim the terrain, and enjoy the pure freedom of flight, accompanied by an original atmospheric soundtrack.

HOTAS Support

Full HOTAS support lets you fly with your preferred stick, throttle, and rudder pedal setup, with or without VR.

Virtual Reality (Optional)

Full VR support includes head tracking and interactive cockpit controls, seamlessly blending traditional inputs with VR controllers.

Aircraft Selection

Pilot a diverse roster of modern and iconic military aircraft, from cutting-edge fighters to legendary combat jets and rotary-wing gunships. Further additions to the fleet will be announced in future updates.

Training & Tutorials

Comprehensive training scenarios teach essential flight and combat skills, from basic handling to advanced maneuvers, weapons employment, evasion, and countermeasures.

Customization & Steam Workshop

Design custom aircraft liveries using the in-game editor, then share them with the community via Steam Workshop.

80s-Inspired Soundtrack

An original soundtrack by Bert “D4XX” Bruggemann, inspired by the bold synth-driven energy of classic 1980s action cinema.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 or AMD FX 8350
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: nVidia GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 480
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • VR Support: VR Supported
  • Additional Notes: Please note: these specs will change as development progresses.

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
